Future<void> run(items, int width) async {
 for (var start = 0; start < items.length; start += width) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  final results = await Future.wait(items.skip(start).take(width).map(read));
  if (failed(results)) {
   await cleanup(results);
   throw Denied();
  }
 }
}
Future<void> caught(items) async {
 for (final item in items) {
  try {
   if (failed(item)) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await cleanup(item);
    throw Denied();
   }
  } catch (_) {}
 }
}
Future<void> inner(items) async {
 for (final item in items) {
  if (failed(item)) {
   for (final child in children) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await cleanup(child);
   }
   throw Denied();
  }
 }
}
